# ExtraAssetsImporter This mod let you import custom surfaces, custom decals and custom NetLanes made of decals.
#### I'm recommending you to read this page on the website not in game, the game doesn't support all the formatting the web page does.
# THESE ARE NOT OFFICIAL ASSETS, THEY ARE MADE BY MODDERS AND ARE NOT SUPPORTED BY PARADOX. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK. The assets are safe and stable to use, and won't cause any crashes or bugs. Whilst we don't expect our asset mods to break, all modding (and unofficial modding) will always have some risk associated with it.
### I'm recommending you to read this page on the website not in game, the game doesn't support all the formatting the web page does.

Publish.ChangeLog:
### New Features - New "Simultaneous asset imports" setting: the new importers can now import several assets at the same time. **Auto** (default) picks a value from your CPU cores and RAM; lower it if the game lags or crashes while importing. - New "Save prefabs (BETA)" setting: saves the imported prefabs to the database so the next launch reloads them instead of rebuilding them from the source files. - New "Reload database (BETA)" button: reloads all the custom assets handled by the new importers without restarting the game. - The new EAI importers are no longer in BETA.
### Improvements - Much faster asset loading with the new importers: textures and assets are imported in parallel. - Faster asset loading with the old importers: their textures are imported in the background, and decals and NetLanes already in the database load about 3 times faster. - Reduced RAM usage when importing surfaces with the old importers. - Assets from disabled or removed mods are now unloaded without deleting their valid database entries. - Detailed import timings are now written in the log.
### Fixes - Fixed a game freeze that could happen while importing assets. - Fixed edited assets not always being detected and rebuilt. - Fixed the database relocation when its saved path was reset but the database still exists on disk. - Fixed the new importers settings being greyed out in the wrong state. - Fixed a memory leak when a texture or decal import fails. - Fixed various stability issues during import.
